produtos.nome: WQ-W4 Pro Electric Scooter 36V 10Ah Battery 350W Motor Recommended Top Speed 25KM/H 8.5inch Tires 25KM/H Top Speed 25-30KM Max Mileage Range 120KG Max Load Folding E-Scooter XIAOMI M365
produtos.descricao:
🛴 【36V 10Ah Removable Lithium Battery】
Enjoy long-distance rides with the high-capacity 36V 10Ah lithium battery. The removable design makes charging simple and convenient at home, work, or wherever you have access to power. Under optimal riding conditions, it provides reliable energy for extended daily commutes.

🛴 【350W High-Torque Motor】
Experience responsive acceleration with the powerful 350W motor system. Engineered to deliver impressive torque, this electric scooter easily navigates steep inclines, city streets, and rugged paths with smooth, consistent power output.

🛴 【Extended Riding Range & Smart Power】
The 36V 10Ah battery system is optimized for maximum efficiency, offering up to 25KM per full charge. Intelligent energy management balances throttle control and pedal/power assist for longer trips.

🛴 【All-Terrain Design & Robust Frame】
Built with a durable, high-strength frame paired with 8.5inch tires for maximum stability and traction. Designed to cushion shocks on uneven pavement, gravel, and dirt roads. Supports a maximum payload capacity of 120KG Max Load.

🛴 【Dual Disc Brakes & Night Safety Lighting】
Features high-precision front and rear disc brakes for strong, predictable stopping power. Integrated ultra-bright LED headlights and rear brake lights ensure maximum visibility during night commutes.

🛴 【Quick Assembly & Warranty Support】
Arrives 85%–90% pre-assembled with setup tools and clear instructions included. Backed by dedicated customer support and standard warranty coverage for total peace of mind.

produtos.descricao:
🚲 【48V 23Ah Removable Lithium Battery】
Enjoy long-distance rides with the high-capacity 48V 23Ah lithium battery. The removable design makes charging simple and convenient at home, work, or wherever you have access to power. Under optimal riding conditions, it provides reliable energy for extended daily commutes.

🚲 【750W*2 High-Torque Motor】
Experience responsive acceleration with the powerful 750W*2 motor system. Engineered to deliver impressive torque, this electric bike easily navigates steep inclines, city streets, and rugged paths with smooth, consistent power output.

🚲 【Extended Riding Range & Smart Power】
The 48V 23Ah battery system is optimized for maximum efficiency, offering up to 25KM per full charge. Intelligent energy management balances throttle control and pedal/power assist for longer trips.

🚲 【All-Terrain Design & Robust Frame】
Built with a durable, high-strength frame paired with 20inch tires for maximum stability and traction. Designed to cushion shocks on uneven pavement, gravel, and dirt roads. Supports a maximum payload capacity of 150KG Max Load.

🚲 【Dual Disc Brakes & Night Safety Lighting】
Features high-precision front and rear disc brakes for strong, predictable stopping power. Integrated ultra-bright LED headlights and rear brake lights ensure maximum visibility during night commutes.

🚲 【Quick Assembly & Warranty Support】
Arrives 85%–90% pre-assembled with setup tools and clear instructions included. Backed by dedicated customer support and standard warranty coverage for total peace of mind.
